items.note: Says it is "for my own use: just me, no accounts".
Asks for a minimal working version ("thinnest slice that works") and says "don't write tests". It does not mention the same-day timing, but the MVP scope is clear.
Asks for a web app with no server and data kept in the browser, and has the receiver start and run it locally.
Specifies "Vite with TypeScript" as the stack.
Says "all data stored locally in the browser" and "data in localStorage".
"Add and delete habits" and the per-habit features mean multiple habits are tracked.
Lists "Mark a habit done for today."
Lists "Show the current streak for each habit."
Lists "Show a simple 30-day history for each habit."
Says "Out of scope: reminders or notifications."
